names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Irinarh», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 28 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Ειρήναρχος και οι Επτά Άγιες Γυναίκες», with the rank word left off.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1087, «Иринарх Севастийский, мч.», with the trailing grade left off. The day line gives only «Иринарха», with no by-name; Sebaste is read from the name page and from the title of the life, «Мученик Иринарх Севастийский и с ним 7 жен».

feast.note: His life page heads itself «День памяти: 28 ноября» and gives no other day.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Иринарха и святых семи жен (303).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Irinarh»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 28ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ειρήναρχος και οι Επτά Άγιες Γυναίκες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it gives the life the Romanian page had none of: a martyr of Sebastia under Diocletian, beheaded in 303. Its heading dates him «(; - 303)». The listing joins him to «οι Επτά Άγιες Γυναίκες», whom the page does not name; the corpus already keeps a `seven-women-of-sebaste` on a venerated Greek 11 Φεβρουαρίου, so that company is reported and not touched. Of the page's two hymns the Ἀπολυτίκιον, which names him, is taken here; the Κάθισμα is neither troparion nor kontakion and is not drafted.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Irinarh, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Irinarh; the common of a martyr, with his name set into it

english.text: Your martyr Irenarchus, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from you, our God; for having your strength he overcame the torturers, and broke also the feeble daring of the demons. By his prayers save our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Εἰρήνης τὸν πρύτανιν, ὁμολογήσας πιστῶς, τῆς πλάνης τὸν τάραχον, κατέλιπες νουνεχῶς, θεόφρον Εἰρήναρχε, ὅθεν δι’ ὕδατος τέ, καὶ πυρὸς ὡς διῆλθες, ἔβης τροπαιοφόρος, πρὸς οὐράνιον λῆξιν, εἰρήνην καὶ σωτηρίαν, πάσιν αἰτούμενος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Ειρήναρχος και οι Επτά Άγιες Γυναίκες», and it names him and plays on his name as a ruler of peace.

english.text: Having faithfully confessed the Lord of peace, you wisely left behind the tumult of error, O godly-minded Irenarchus; and so, as one who had passed through water and fire, you went as a trophy-bearer to your heavenly end, asking peace and salvation for all.

death.note: saint.gr: «τον οποίο υπέστη με πλήρη αγαλλίαση το 303 μ.Χ.», and its own heading for him reads «(; - 303)».
